cases.citation: The original Z80 source sends the nine bits of bank value one least-significant-bit first to 0x6000, reads 16 bytes from 0x8000, and copies each byte with LDIR to 0x1000; the original enclosing ROM places this marker at 68000 offset 0x8000.
SN76489 tone formula f = Z80 clock / (32*N); VA3 NTSC-U Z80 clock is 3579545 Hz and original guest writes N=128.
The original Z80 guest writes tone latch 0x80, period high bits 0x08, then attenuation 0x90 to memory port 0x7F11 in this order.
